subject: RFI: Security control mapping + evidence plan for AmberTech
messages:
From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@ambertech.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: AmberTech Procurement <procurement@ambertech.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 15:04:00 -0400
Subject: RFI: Security controls mapping and evidence for Redwood Inference

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this — AmberTech is putting Redwood through a standard vetting ahead of our pilot. I've attached our SIG-style questionnaire (XLSX) that focuses on SOC 2 / ISO controls and evidence we need to verify. High level asks:

- A controls-to-evidence mapping (where each SIG control rows map to your SOC 2/ISO artifacts)
- Representative artifacts (SOC 2 report, ISO statement OR audit summary, network diagram, data flow)
- Dates for when we can expect artifact delivery and a short mutual action plan (MAP)

Our procurement deadline for the pilot contract is 2026-07-09; ideally we have the mapping and initial artifacts by 2026-07-02. If that timeline doesn't work, say so and propose alternatives.

Attached: ambertech_SIG_questionnaire.xlsx

Best,
Lydia
Principal, Vendor Risk
AmberTech Security

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@ambertech.com>
Cc: AmberTech Procurement <procurement@ambertech.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: RFI: Security controls mapping and evidence for Redwood Inference

Hi Lydia — thanks for sending this and for the timeline. We can meet the 07/02 target for an initial delivery of mapped controls and a first artifact bundle. Plan below:

1) By 2026-07-02: Controls mapping (SIG -> SOC 2 + ISO artifact pointers) + bundled artifacts (SOC 2 summary, ISO statement, network diagram, selected evidence files).
2) By 2026-07-06: Complete evidence set (drive access + delegated reviewers).
3) MAP: quick sync to confirm any clarifications (30 mins) — propose 2026-07-01 09:00 PT.

Attached for now: redwood_SOC2_typeII_summary.pdf, redwood_iso27001_statement.pdf, redwood_network_diagram_2026.png

Action items for AmberTech: confirm if the 07/01 sync works and whether the questionnaire should be completed in-line (we can pre-fill recommended answers in the sheet).

I'll loop in Marissa and Rishi to own artifact collection and control mapping.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 16:15:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: RFI: Security controls mapping and evidence for Redwood Inference

Team — forwarding AmberTech's SIG-style questionnaire. Goal: produce the mapping and initial artifact bundle by EOD 2026-07-02.

Quick breakdown:
- Marissa: SOC 2 artifacts and access to evidence (drive).
- Rishi: control mapping (SIG rows to SOC 2/ISO evidence strings) + short narrative for any control gaps and compensating controls.
- Vivek: network diagram and environment-specific notes (VPC, private deployments, data residency).

Keep it concise; external ask will prefer links to documents rather than attaching everything. We'll provide a pre-filled questionnaire tab with references to Drive items + the PDF bundle.

Thanks — Kim

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: RFI: Security controls mapping and evidence for Redwood Inference

Following up with artifact locations. I've assembled a 'starter bundle' in Drive and set viewer access for lydia.park@ambertech.com. Contents:

- redwood_SOC2_typeII_summary.pdf (summary + assertion page)
- SOC2 evidence folder (logs-retention-policy.pdf, user-provisioning-proof.txt, IAM-audit-report-2026-05.pdf)
- redwood_iso27001_statement.pdf
- redwood_network_diagram_2026.png

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-evidence

Note: SOC 2 Type II full report is under NDA — we can provide to AmberTech after a standard NDA or via a secure viewer. For the mapping, I'm attaching a short CSV (referenced in Drive) that links SIG control IDs to the SOC/ISO evidence files.

I'll mark the controls that require clarifying questions in column 'Q'. Rishi, please pick up the mapping refinement and narratives. Vivek, confirm the diagram notes for private deployments.

-M

Attachments: (drive links only; no bulk files attached)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 11:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: RFI: Security controls mapping and evidence for Redwood Inference

Marissa — I reviewed the starter mapping and added suggested answer text for the SIG columns (controls we map to SOC 2 CC and ISO annex). A few notes:

- SIG control SIG-3 (data retention and deletion): mapped to SOC2 CC-6 and retention policy. We should surface the retention window for hosted vs. private deployments (30/90/365 days in naive wording).
- SIG-7 (third-party management): link to our vendor onboarding checklist and change control log (both in Drive).
- For any control that references encryption at rest, call out KMS integration options (cloud KMS vs customer-managed HSM for Private).

I added a short 'residual risk' note where mapping is not 1:1. I'll prepare the pre-filled questionnaire tab and push to the Drive folder by EOD (2026-07-02).

-Rishi

From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@ambertech.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: AmberTech Procurement <procurement@ambertech.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@ambertech.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 14:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: RFI: Security controls mapping and evidence for Redwood Inference

Kim / team — thanks, this looks good so far. I can access the Drive folder and review the starter bundle. Two quick asks:

1) Can you export the pre-filled questionnaire as an XLSX (so our GRC tool can ingest it)?
2) Please put a short MAP (mutual action plan) in plain bullets with owner names and target dates for outstanding items (SOC2 full report NDA, encryption specifics for Private, and evidence for change control).

If you can get those two items to us by EOD 2026-07-06 we'll be in good shape for procurement next week. Also — we prefer DocuSign links for the NDA; share when ready.

Best,
Lydia
